name: Verification 8
definition: Method and data intended to be verified as well as the related results.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of authentication or verification. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

SubType.name: Sub Type
SubType.definition: Type of authentication for a given method (for example, three domain authentication, scheme proprietary solution, type of cryptogram, etc.).

PINData.name: PIN Data
PINData.definition: Personal Identification Number data.|ISO 13492 and ISO 9564-1

Entity.name: Entity
Entity.definition: Entity who actually performed the verification. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

Result.name: Result
Result.definition: Result of the verification. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.
